maria (Docs): Quick sync — PR #6230 needs a tiny docs pass. Streaming + pagination snippets (py/ts/go) should mention resume-token TTL, jittered retry pattern, and a fallback to polling. Can someone update the snippet files?

sam (SDK): I can coordinate. Which paths?

maria (Docs): docs/snippets/sdk/streaming/*, examples/get-started/stream-paginate/README.md, and docs/guides/pagination.md (one-line note). Keep examples minimal.

eli (PY SDK): Python draft pushed: show jittered backoff + resume handling. Short example: ```py
retry = Retry(jitter=True, base=0.1, max=2.0)
for chunk in client.stream(req, retry=retry):
    if getattr(chunk, 'resume_token', None): save(chunk.resume_token)
    print(chunk.text)
```

jon (Go eng): Go snippet incoming: context timeout + reconnect hint. ```go
ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 20*time.Second)
defer cancel()
stream, _ := client.Stream(ctx, req)
for c := range stream.Chunks() { fmt.Println(c.Text) }
// use exp backoff + jitter when reconnecting
```

linda (TS SDK): TS async-iterator added; typed resumeToken as string|undefined. ```ts
for await (const p of client.stream(req)) {
  if (p.resumeToken) store(p.resumeToken)
  console.log(p.text)
}
```

maria (Docs): Editorial asks: 1) add explicit line: "Resume tokens expire after 24 hours; persist tokens if you may resume." 2) add a one-paragraph fallback: if resume fails, switch to polling pages. Give tiny pseudocode: ```pseudo
while has_more: page = client.list_pages(cursor); process(page); cursor = page.next_cursor
```
 3) add one-line note: "set batch_size for throughput vs latency trade-offs."

ci-bot: docs preview for PR 6230: https://deploy.preview/docs/pr-6230 (build passed) :white_check_mark:

sam (SDK): I'll review PY/GO shapes and post micro-nits. Aim to merge before Thursday release cut. Ping me or @maria if blocked.
